## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the problem, why this change is needed, and the observable result.
Link the related issue, if any.

## Compatibility

Describe any public API, AT command, stored setting, board, or dependency
impact. Include migration steps when needed, or state that none apply.

## Validation

List commands and results, tested board targets and hardware revisions,
and any behavior you could not test. Include reproduction or regression
evidence for bug fixes.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Commits are independent logical changes with explanatory messages.
- [ ] Every commit has its author's DCO sign-off; no merge or fixup commits.
- [ ] Relevant tests, samples, and documentation are updated.
- [ ] User-visible changes and migration steps are recorded under
      `Unreleased` in `CHANGELOG.md`, or this change needs no changelog entry.
- [ ] No credentials, temporary files, or generated build output are included.
